svg.title: The failure loop
svg.desc: A returned observation changes the next attempt and control. FT/Fighter geometry passed while visual design missed; the diagnostic is illustrative, not a product capture. System model: The failure loop. Expectation State what should happen. Attempt A reviewable change. REALITY. Name the miss What escaped the checks?. Change the control Prevent the same class of failure. Recheck Try the same failure again. FT / FIGHTER Geometry passed. Design missed. Independent visual criticism became a separate check.. FT / Fighter: geometry passed while design missed. Public founding account 28 September 2026; reviewed 18 October 2026. The illustrative diagnostic is not a product screenshot.
